# Roedy Rustam — AI Systems & Agentic Developer × Agro-Tech Sociopreneur
> Official AI indexing summary and Knowledge Graph for Roedy Rustam: Konsultan IT, Praktisi AI, Trainer IT/UMKM bersertifikasi BNSP, and Konsultan UMKM Indonesia. Combines frontier agentic AI engineering (Model Context Protocol, multi-agent swarms) with industrial engineering in coffee supply chains and rural cooperatives in Sulawesi, Indonesia.

- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vibes-plug
- Location: Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia (Coordinates: -5.1477, 119.4327)
- Organization: Sehati Kopi Indonesia

## Primary Professional Roles (Indonesia & Global)
- [Konsultan IT Indonesia](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev): Enterprise IT architecture advisory, performance audits, and modern edge computing migrations (Cloudflare Workers, React 19 SSR). Verified by production repositories like [API-Wilayah-2024](https://github.com/roedyrustam/API-Wilayah-2024) (21★) and live platforms [BeanHub](https://beanhub.online) and [CuppingNotes](https://cuppingnotes.online).
- [Praktisi AI Indonesia](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev): Specialist in Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.x), multi-agent swarms, and AI Control Planes. Author of [vibes-plug](https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug) (77★, npm package with 155 specialized skills for Google Antigravity & Claude Code), [Centaury Engine](https://github.com/roedyrustam/centaury) (Gemini 4 Pro / Project Astra runtime), [sinapsai](https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai) (in-process AI Gateway), and [doku-gemini-mcp](https://github.com/roedyrustam/doku-gemini-mcp).
- [Trainer IT & Pelatih Kewirausahaan UMKM](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/about): Nationally certified by BNSP (Badan Nasional Sertifikasi Profesi) as Pelatih Kewirausahaan UMKM (Cert: KWR.018.00412.2023). Conducts workshops on generative AI, cashier digitization, and community digital literacy.
- [Konsultan UMKM & Koperasi Desa](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/about): Business advisor for rural MSMEs, creator of Kafeya POS (offline-first accounting & POS), and certified agro planner under BNSP Sektor Industri Agro — Klaster Perencanaan Produksi (Cert: AGR.024.00192.2019).

## Flagship Projects & Case Studies
- [AgroAgent MCP Server](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agroagent-mcp): An enterprise-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.x) server connecting LLM agents to coffee harvest telemetry, sensory scores, and supply chain ERP APIs.
- [Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agent-swarm): Autonomous 4-agent collaborative pipeline coordinating harvest scouting, SCA sensory cupping analysis, logistics routing, and escrow verification.
- [BeanHub](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/beanhub): Digital coffee supply chain platform connecting smallholder farmers to roasteries across Barru, Toraja, Sinjai, and Enrekang.
- [CuppingNotes](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/cuppingnotes): Mobile-first SCA coffee cupping application featuring an interactive flavor radar wheel, automated scoring, and shareable lot profiles.
- [Kafeya POS](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/kafeya): Offline-first point of sale and micro-accounting system built specifically for small coffee shop owners and rural UMKM in Indonesia.
- [Pandu Desa 4.0](https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/pandudesa): Digital transformation initiative for village governance, spatial mapping, and local commodity sovereignty.

## Open Source & Developer Tooling
- [vibes-plug](https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug): 77★, 19 forks, published npm package (`vibes-plug`). Universal Skill AI Agent Swarm Architecture for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf orchestrating 155 specialized subagents.
- [Centaury Engine](https://github.com/roedyrustam/centaury): Autonomous fullstack engine for super-intelligent systems (Gemini 4 Pro, Project Astra, Dual-Citizen MCP v1.x, zero-hydration signals).
- [sinapsai](https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai): 4★, 3 forks. In-process AI Gateway & Control Plane with Circuit Breaker, automatic failover, and unified LLM API for Node.js & TypeScript.
- [doku-gemini-mcp](https://github.com/roedyrustam/doku-gemini-mcp): Model Context Protocol server connecting Gemini & Antigravity agents to DOKU Payment Gateway (VA, QRIS, SNAP BI).
- [API-Wilayah-2024](https://github.com/roedyrustam/API-Wilayah-2024): 21★, 10 forks. Indonesian administrative geographic hierarchy database and open REST API for village-level spatial queries.
- [macli](https://github.com/roedyrustam/macli): Autonomous multi-agent CLI tooling and execution runtime.
